e.title: 把**方法版本**做成一个可以并排看的东西**：一个准备金自动化平台让分析师**在采用某个链梯法的改动之前，先比任意两个历史版本**（**高亮哪一版更新，并排显示比率选择、公式与备注的快照，再由人决定留哪一版**），**并说明这样做是为了「在覆盖假设之前有一个明确的复核步骤」**；**它同时把**面向 AI 代理的操作授权按组件切分****（**逐字「授权是按组件划分的；停掉一个从不授权你停掉另一个」**）
e.title_en: Making a method version something you can look at side by side: a reserving automation platform lets analysts compare any two historical versions of a chain-ladder method before adopting a change, highlighting which is newer and showing side-by-side snapshots of ratio selections, formulas and notes for a human to choose from, with the stated purpose of giving actuaries a clear review step before overwriting assumptions — while also splitting standing authorisation for AI agents component by component
e.title_hk: 把**方法版本**做成一個可以並排看的東西**：一個準備金自動化平台讓分析師**在採用某個鏈梯法的改動之前，先比任意兩個歷史版本**（**高亮哪一版更新，並排顯示比率選擇、公式與備註的快照，再由人決定留哪一版**），**並說明這樣做是為了「在覆蓋假設之前有一個明確的複核步驟」**；**它同時把**面向 AI 代理的操作授權按組件切分****（**逐字「授權是按組件劃分的；停掉一個從不授權你停掉另一個」**）
e.summary: 一个**准备金自动化平台**（★1、Python、仓库体量 26 MB）：**它把「三角形」从**预先算好**改成**按需查询****——**逐字「ArcRho 用对分析就绪源数据的**按需查询**取代那种模式，**并通过熟悉的 Excel 公式暴露出来**」**，**并给出与「传统厂商平台」的逐项对照表**（**其中一行逐字为「只存源数据」对「每个项目 10,000 个以上预先算好的数据集」**）；**其最值得记的一处是它把**方法版本**做成了可比对象****——**逐字「方法版本比较让团队在采用改动之前，先复核一个链梯法的**任意两个历史版本**。比较视图**高亮哪一版更新**，**并排显示比率选择、公式与备注的快照**，**并让用户选择保留哪一版**。**这给了分析师一个明确的复核步骤，在覆盖假设之前**，**减少意外漂移，同时保持协作速度**」**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① **它把「覆盖假设」当成一个需要**显式通过**的关口****（**⭐ 即**版本标签的作用是**让"改成什么"看得见**）；**② **它把**面向 AI 代理的授权做成按组件切分的许可****（**逐字「授权是按**组件**划分的。**停掉一个组件从不授权你停掉另一个**」**，**并有两条硬规矩**：**逐字「**绝不部署没有通过检查的改动**」与「**构建失败会让已部署的组件保持原样**」**）**；**③ **它把代理的记忆、技能与指令一并放进公开仓库****（**实测 `agent-memory/` 下 **81 份 markdown**、`.claude/skills/` 下 **6 个具名技能**、`agent-instructions/` 下 **7 份指令**，**根目录另有 `AGENTS.md`／`AGENT_GUIDELINES.md`／`CLAUDE.md` 三份**）**——⚠️ **但本词条同时如实记下：该仓库**没有许可声明**，**且其中包含可识别的内部运行细节与第三方软件的具名资料**，**故使用前应当先看这两件事****
e.summary_hk: 一個**準備金自動化平台**（★1、Python、體量 26 MB）：**它把「三角形」從**預先算好**改成**按需查詢****——**逐字「ArcRho 用對分析就緒源數據的**按需查詢**取代那種模式，**並通過熟悉的 Excel 公式暴露出來**」**，**並給出與「傳統廠商平台」的逐項對照表**（**其中一行逐字為「只存源數據」對「每個項目 10,000 個以上預先算好的數據集」**）；**其最值得記的一處是它把**方法版本**做成了可比對象****——**逐字「方法版本比較讓團隊在採用改動之前，先複核一個鏈梯法的**任意兩個歷史版本**。比較視圖**高亮哪一版更新**，**並排顯示比率選擇、公式與備註的快照**，**並讓用戶選擇保留哪一版**。**這給了分析師一個明確的複核步驟，在覆蓋假設之前**，**減少意外漂移，同時保持協作速度**」**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① **它把「覆蓋假設」當成一個需要**顯式通過**的關口**；**② **它把**面向 AI 代理的授權做成按組件切分的許可****（**逐字「授權是按**組件**劃分的。**停掉一個組件從不授權你停掉另一個**」**，**並有兩條硬規矩**：**逐字「**絕不部署沒有通過檢查的改動**」與「**構建失敗會讓已部署的組件保持原樣**」**）**；**③ **它把代理的記憶、技能與指令一併放進公開倉庫****（**實測 `agent-memory/` 下 **81 份 markdown**、`.claude/skills/` 下 **6 個具名技能**、`agent-instructions/` 下 **7 份指令**，**根目錄另有 `AGENTS.md`／`AGENT_GUIDELINES.md`／`CLAUDE.md`**）**——⚠️ **但本詞條同時如實記下：該倉庫**沒有許可聲明**，**且其中包含可識別的內部運行細節與第三方軟件的具名資料**，**故使用前應當先看這兩件事****
e.summary_en: A reserving automation platform — 1 star, Python, a 26 MB repository — that replaces pre-computed triangles with on-demand queries against analytics-ready source data exposed through familiar spreadsheet formulas, and publishes a line-by-line comparison against a traditional vendor platform whose storage row contrasts storing only source data with more than ten thousand pre-computed datasets per project. **Its most notable feature is that it makes a method version an object you can compare**: verbatim, method version compare lets teams review any two historical versions of a chain-ladder method before adopting changes, the comparison view highlighting which version is newer, showing side-by-side snapshots of ratio selections, formulas and notes, and letting users choose which version to keep, so that actuaries get a clear review step before overwriting assumptions while reducing accidental drift. **Three further points follow the same discipline**: it treats overwriting an assumption as a gate that must be passed explicitly; **it splits standing authorisation for AI agents component by component**, verbatim that the authorisation is per component and that stopping one never authorises stopping another, with two hard rules that a change which has not passed its checks is never deployed and that a failed build leaves the deployed component untouched; **and it commits its agent memory, skills and instructions into the public repository**, with 81 markdown memories, 6 named skills, 7 instruction files and three root-level agent documents measured — ⚠️ while this entry also records plainly that the repository carries no licence statement and that it contains identifiable internal operating detail and named third-party material, so both should be checked before use.
e.body:
**arcrho-reserving-platform**（仓库 `xw2781/ArcRho`）**是一份面向**准备金分析**的自动化平台**：**逐字自述为**「**ArcRho is an actuarial data automation platform focused on loss reserving analytics, with an emphasis on streamlining the end-to-end data preparation pipeline.**」**（**一个精算数据自动化平台，专注于损失准备金分析，并着力于把端到端的数据准备流程打通**）。**实测 ★1、fork 0、许可字段为 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信号一致，见下**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **26,325 KB**、**创建 2026-01-13**、最后推送 2026-09-10、有描述**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建在解冻窗口之前**，**推送落在窗口之内****）；**README 实测 8,900 字节**；**仓库实测共 **3,351 个条目（2,966 个文件、385 个目录）**（**经 codeload tarball 实测列出**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「标签：每个数都带着它的标签」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**唯一一条把「版本」当成需要先看过再覆盖的标签来做的****。

可核实信息（**均 README、仓库文件清单与仓库内文档实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把「换成哪一版」做成了一件可以先并排看的事**——**逐字为**：**「**Method Version Compare helps teams review any two historical versions of a chain-ladder method before adopting changes. The comparison view highlights which version is newer, shows side-by-side snapshots of ratio selections, formulas, and notes, and lets users choose which version to keep. This gives actuaries a clear review step before overwriting assumptions, reducing accidental drift while keeping collaboration fast.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **比较的对象被点名是**比率选择、公式与备注**三件**——**⭐ 即**被比较的不只是结果，**而是**做出这个结果的三个东西****（**⭐ 与第 344 轮 [[insurek-swiss-deductible]] 一族的「把依据放在看得见的地方」同向，**但这里针对的是**时间上的两个版本**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「哪一版更新」被**高亮**，**而没有交给读者去判断****（**⭐ 即**版本的方向本身也是一个标签**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一点很实用：**实务里最常见的错误不是选错版本，**而是**搞不清哪一版是新的****）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「让用户选择保留哪一版」把决定权留给人**，**且**逐字说明目的**是「**在覆盖假设之前有一个明确的复核步骤**」**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[prediction-lab-actuarial]] 的「审批保持为人类专属且不可逆」、第 345 轮 [[corredor-broker-platform]] 的「人的决定永远优先」同族**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **它给自己的收益下了一个很克制的定义**：**「减少意外漂移，同时保持协作速度」**——**⭐ 即**不是「防止错误」，**而是**减少**无意的**漂移****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「三角形」的算法模型改了，并给出与旧做法的逐项对照**——**逐字为**：**「ArcRho replaces that model with **on-demand queries against analytics-ready source data, exposed through familiar Excel formulas**.」**，**其对照表逐字含**：**「**数据存法**：规范化的细粒度事实表 对 固定的层级项目树」「**存储占用**：只存源数据 对 每个项目 10,000 个以上预先算好的数据集」「**基础设施**：在任何机器上本地运行 对 依赖远端服务器／厂商应用」**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **交付面选的是 Excel**（**其函数以 `ArcRho` 为前缀，**逐字列出 `ArcRhoTri`／`ArcRhoTriDiag`／`ArcRhoTriCell`／`ArcRhoVec` 等八个 UDF**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条**最贴近实务的一处**：**准备金团队真的在用 Excel**；**② ⭐⭐ **「10,000 个以上预先算好的数据集」是一个**可对照的具体数字****（**⭐ 即**它用旧做法的代价**来说自己的理由**）；**③ ⭐ **其架构图逐字给出两端**（**Excel 侧经 UDF 发出请求，Python 引擎侧经看门狗监听、内存缓存、过滤与透视后构出三角形，**并把结果回给 Excel**）**——**⭐ 实测其仓库确有一条**独立的工程分层**（`excel-addin/` 51 项、`python-api/` 344 项、`server-components/` 120 项、`frontend/` 2,612 项**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把面向 AI 代理的**授权**也做成了有范围的标签**——**其根目录一份指令文件逐字写明**：**「**The authorization is per component. Stopping one never authorizes stopping another**」**（**授权是按组件划分的；停掉一个组件从不授权你停掉另一个**），**并逐条给出每个组件的**代价与部署后验证方式****（**例如逐字说明某个组件停机会让**所有待处理的计算与依赖传播任务暂停**，**而另一个组件停机**不影响任何正在运行的东西**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **授权按组件切分**，**并明文禁止把一次授权外推到另一个组件**——**⭐ 这是本站所收条目里**对「代理能做什么」写得最具体的一处**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[kokuho-rules-engine]] 的「自定义非 OSI 许可＋逐项事先许可清单」在**权限形状**上同族，**但对象是**代理操作**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **逐字「绝不部署没有通过检查的改动」**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **逐字「构建失败会让已部署的组件保持原样」**，**并补充说明失败路径**（**构建脚本宁可中止也不半部署；**实例在超时内停不下来、或切换被回滚，**都保留已部署的东西**）**——**⭐ 即**失败被设计成**幂等的保守侧****；**④ ⭐⭐ **它要求代理在每次回复里**报出改了哪几个组件****（**逐字「**state in the final response** which components were rebuilt, redeployed, and relaunched, or why none were」**）**——**⭐ 即**「我动了什么」必须随回复一起交出来****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把代理的**记忆、技能与指令**一并放进了公开仓库（**这是本条的另一个侧面，**也是本轮最需要标注的一处**）**——**实测**：**`agent-memory/` 下 **81 份 markdown**（**含一份索引 `MEMORY.md`，**逐条指向各条记忆**）；**`.claude/skills/` 下 **6 个具名技能**（**每个含 `SKILL.md`，**其中若干另有 `agents/openai.yaml`**）；**`agent-instructions/` 下 **7 份指令**（**含「组件部署授权」、「代理的项目数据访问」、「组件部署授权」之类按主题切分的文件**）；**根目录另有 `AGENTS.md`／`AGENT_GUIDELINES.md`／`CLAUDE.md` 三份**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **记忆是**按主题一条一档**存的**（**实测档名如「新增一种托管保存类型」、「某类数据集类型优先于旧系统」、「开发界面缓存与重启」**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是**把代理的经验做成可检索资产**的一种做法**；**② ⭐⭐ **它把一次**演练写进在线数据的事故**写在记忆里并给出预防**（**⭐ 本词条**按站内既定做法不转载**其中的机器名、路径与类名；**只记其形状**：一条以「**DANGER**」开头的记忆说明**一次所谓的临时演练把数据写进了在线类**，**并给出三条预防**——**先探路径、先按字节复制类、并优先采用网关回执中的原因**）**。**⑤ ⭐ 一处与版本标签同向的提交信息（**经 GitHub 提交检索实测读到**）**：**其一次提交的标题逐字为**「**fix(methods): keep a calculated number at the precision it was observed with**」**（**修（方法）：让一个算出来的数保持在它被观察到的那个精度上**）——**⭐ 本词条认为这与本轮主题完全同向**，**故一并记下**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[chainladder-python]]、[[reservingmodels]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[ibnr-app]]、[[insurance-analytical-case-studies]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **三重信号一致指向**没有许可声明****：**GitHub 许可字段为 **NONE****、**实测根目录 `LICENSE` 与 `LICENSE.md` 均不存在**（**raw 探测均为 HTTP 404**）、**且 README 全文以「licen／copyright／©」检索**零命中****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**信号最完整的一次「无许可」记录**（**⚠️ 无许可不等于不可读，**但**「可以读到」与「可以再分发」是两件事****）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本词条指出一件比许可更需要先看的事：**该仓库公开了其运行环境的可识别内部细节与第三方软件的具名资料****——**⭐ 已实测**在**公开的** `agent-memory/` 中同时存在**内部机器名、盘符与服务账号路径、某个商用准备金软件的接口逆向说明、以及上述那次把演练写进在线类的事故记录**；**⚠️ 本词条**按站内既定做法**不转载这些可识别的内部标识、路径、机器名与该第三方软件的具名细节**（**⭐ 理由：**词条本身不应成为这些信息的二次传播渠道**），**但**把「这件事在公开仓库里」**本身**作为**使用与引用前应当先了解的一点**写明**（**⚠️ 本词条**不评价其是否合规、是否已获授权、或是否违反任何协议——**未查任何法规或协议**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未安装、未运行该平台****——**未安装 Python 依赖、未启动引擎或任何组件、未加载 Excel 加载项、未打开其前端、未运行任何测试、未打开其任何图片（**实测其 `assets/` 下有多张截图，**均未打开**）**；**故**本词条**不主张**其按需查询可跑通、其版本比较可用、或其与厂商平台的对照表在任何意义上成立**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明、其仓库内文档的逐字内容，**与其经 tarball 实测的文件结构**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其源码实现****（**⭐ 即**未核对**：版本比较是否确实按所述显示三件快照、**「构建失败保持原样」是否确实由脚本保证**、**其 UDF 是否确实在 Excel 中可用**）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其价格、部署方式或商业模式**（**⭐ 其 README 对「厂商依赖」的批评指向未具名的传统平台**，**本词条**不据此评价任何厂商**）。**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**该平台适用于任何机构**（**⭐ 其 `demo-data/` 实测只有一份 CSV，**且**本词条未读其内容**）。**⑦ ⚠️ **★1、fork 0**，**且**未核实其作者背景**（**⭐ 其记忆文件里另有一条关于**提交署名**的记录，**本词条不转载其身份信息**）。**⑧ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之前（2026-01-13）****——**⭐ 如实记录该日期**，**其入选依据是**推送落在窗口之内（2026-09-10）**。**⑨ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/xw2781/ArcRho` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可字段 NONE、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；README 8,900 字节、根目录 `LICENSE`／`LICENSE.md` 探测、`agent-instructions/component-deployment-authorization.md`、`agent-memory/MEMORY.md` 与其一份记忆全文均经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 与 tarball 实测逐字核对；**文件清单与各目录项数经 codeload tarball 实测（3,351 个条目：2,966 文件、385 目录）**；**其一次提交信息经 GitHub 提交检索接口实测读到**；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何脚本或程序、未打开任何图、未做任何网络观察**。
e.body_hk:
**arcrho-reserving-platform**（倉庫 `xw2781/ArcRho`）**是一份面向**準備金分析**的自動化平台**：**逐字自述為**「**ArcRho is an actuarial data automation platform focused on loss reserving analytics, with an emphasis on streamlining the end-to-end data preparation pipeline.**」**。**實測 ★1、fork 0、許可字段為 **NONE****（**⚠️ 三重信號一致，見下**）、主語言 Python、體量 **26,325 KB**、**創建 2026-01-13**、最後推送 2026-09-10、有描述**（**創建在解凍窗口之前**，**推送落在窗口之內****）；**README 實測 8,900 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 3,351 個條目（2,966 個文件、385 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「標籤：每個數都帶著它的標籤」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本輪四條裡**唯一一條把「版本」當成需要先看過再覆蓋的標籤來做的****。

可核實資訊（**均 README、倉庫文件清單與倉庫內文檔實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把「換成哪一版」做成了一件可以先並排看的事**——**逐字為**：**「**Method Version Compare helps teams review any two historical versions of a chain-ladder method before adopting changes. The comparison view highlights which version is newer, shows side-by-side snapshots of ratio selections, formulas, and notes, and lets users choose which version to keep. This gives actuaries a clear review step before overwriting assumptions, reducing accidental drift while keeping collaboration fast.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐比較的對象被點名是**比率選擇、公式與備註**三件**（被比較的不只是結果，而是**做出這個結果的三個東西**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「哪一版更新」被**高亮**，而沒有交給讀者去判斷**（版本的方向本身也是一個標籤；實務裡最常見的錯誤不是選錯版本，而是**搞不清哪一版是新的**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐「讓用戶選擇保留哪一版」把決定權留給人**，且**逐字說明目的**是「**在覆蓋假設之前有一個明確的複核步驟**」（與第 342 輪 prediction-lab-actuarial 的「審批保持為人類專屬且不可逆」、第 345 輪 corredor-broker-platform 的「人的決定永遠優先」同族）；**④ ⭐⭐它給自己的收益下了一個很克制的定義**：「減少意外漂移，同時保持協作速度」（不是「防止錯誤」，而是**減少**無意的**漂移**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「三角形」的算法模型改了，並給出與舊做法的逐項對照**——**逐字「ArcRho replaces that model with **on-demand queries against analytics-ready source data, exposed through familiar Excel formulas**.」**，其對照表逐字含「**數據存法**：規範化的細粒度事實表 對 固定的層級項目樹」「**存儲佔用**：只存源數據 對 每個項目 10,000 個以上預先算好的數據集」「**基礎設施**：在任何機器上本地運行 對 依賴遠端伺服器／廠商應用」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐交付面選的是 Excel**（函數以 `ArcRho` 為前綴，逐字列出 `ArcRhoTri`／`ArcRhoTriDiag`／`ArcRhoTriCell`／`ArcRhoVec` 等八個 UDF——**準備金團隊真的在用 Excel**）；**② ⭐⭐「10,000 個以上預先算好的數據集」是一個可對照的具體數字**；**③ ⭐其架構圖逐字給出兩端**（Excel 側經 UDF 發出請求，Python 引擎側經看門狗監聽、內存緩存、過濾與透視後構出三角形，並把結果回給 Excel）；實測其倉庫確有一條**獨立的工程分層**（`excel-addin/` 51 項、`python-api/` 344 項、`server-components/` 120 項、`frontend/` 2,612 項）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把面向 AI 代理的**授權**也做成了有範圍的標籤**——**逐字「**The authorization is per component. Stopping one never authorizes stopping another**」**，並逐條給出每個組件的**代價與部署後驗證方式**（例如某個組件停機會讓**所有待處理的計算與依賴傳播任務暫停**，而另一個組件停機**不影響任何正在運行的東西**）**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐授權按組件切分，並明文禁止把一次授權外推到另一個組件**（這是本站所收條目裡**對「代理能做什麼」寫得最具體的一處**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐逐字「絕不部署沒有通過檢查的改動」**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐逐字「構建失敗會讓已部署的組件保持原樣」**，並補充失敗路徑（構建腳本寧可中止也不半部署；實例在超時內停不下來、或切換被回滾，都保留已部署的東西——**失敗被設計成**冪等的保守側**）；**④ ⭐⭐它要求代理在每次回覆裡**報出改了哪幾個組件****（逐字「**state in the final response** which components were rebuilt, redeployed, and relaunched, or why none were」）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把代理的**記憶、技能與指令**一併放進了公開倉庫**——**實測**：`agent-memory/` 下 **81 份 markdown**（含一份索引 `MEMORY.md`）；`.claude/skills/` 下 **6 個具名技能**（每個含 `SKILL.md`，其中若干另有 `agents/openai.yaml`）；`agent-instructions/` 下 **7 份指令**；根目錄另有 `AGENTS.md`／`AGENT_GUIDELINES.md`／`CLAUDE.md` 三份**兩處**：**① ⭐⭐記憶是**按主題一條一檔**存的**（檔名如「新增一種託管保存類型」、「某類數據集類型優先於舊系統」、「開發界面緩存與重啟」——**把代理的經驗做成可檢索資產**）；**② ⭐⭐它把一次**演練寫進在線數據的事故**寫在記憶裡並給出預防**（**本詞條按站內既定做法不轉載**其中的機器名、路徑與類名；只記其形狀：一條以「**DANGER**」開頭的記憶說明**一次所謂的臨時演練把數據寫進了在線類**，並給出三條預防——**先探路徑、先按位元組複製類、並優先採用網關回執中的原因**）。**⑤ ⭐ 一處與版本標籤同向的提交信息**：**其一次提交的標題逐字為**「**fix(methods): keep a calculated number at the precision it was observed with**」（修（方法）：讓一個算出來的數保持在它被觀察到的那個精度上）——⭐本詞條認為這與本輪主題完全同向。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[chainladder-python]]、[[reservingmodels]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[ibnr-app]]、[[insurance-analytical-case-studies]] 並讀**。

**arcrho-reserving-platform** (repository `xw2781/ArcRho`) **is an automation platform for loss reserving analysis**, describing itself verbatim as an actuarial data automation platform focused on loss reserving analytics with an emphasis on streamlining the end-to-end data preparation pipeline. **Measured 1 star, 0 forks, a licence field of NONE** — ⚠️ three signals agreeing, as set out below — **primary language Python, a 26,325 KB repository, created 2026-01-13, last pushed 2026-09-10, with a description** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation predates the thaw window while the push falls inside it**); **the README measures 8,900 bytes**; **the repository measures 3,351 entries, 2,966 files and 385 directories**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **labels carried by everything**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the only one treating a version as a label to read before overwriting**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, the file listing and documents inside the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It makes choosing which version to adopt something you can look at side by side** — verbatim, method version compare helps teams review any two historical versions of a chain-ladder method before adopting changes, the comparison view highlights which version is newer, shows side-by-side snapshots of ratio selections, formulas and notes, and lets users choose which version to keep, which gives actuaries a clear review step before overwriting assumptions while reducing accidental drift and keeping collaboration fast ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **what gets compared is named as three things, ratio selections, formulas and notes, so it is not only the result but the three things that produced it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **which version is newer is highlighted rather than left to the reader, making the direction of a version a label of its own**, ⭐ **and the entry notes that the common practical error is not choosing the wrong version but losing track of which one is new**; ⭐⭐⭐ **letting users choose which version to keep leaves the decision with a person, with the stated purpose of a clear review step before overwriting assumptions**, ⭐ **the same family as round 342’s approval being human-only and irreversible and round 345’s human decision always winning**; **and ⭐⭐ it defines its own benefit modestly, as reducing accidental drift while keeping collaboration fast rather than preventing error**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It changed the computational model behind a triangle and sets out a line-by-line comparison with the old approach** — verbatim, it replaces that model with **on-demand queries against analytics-ready source data, exposed through familiar spreadsheet formulas**, and its comparison table states verbatim that the data structure is a normalised grain-level fact table against a fixed hierarchical project tree, that the storage footprint is source data only against more than ten thousand pre-computed datasets per project, and that the infrastructure runs locally on any machine against depending on a remote server and vendor application ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **the delivery surface chosen is the spreadsheet**, with eight user-defined functions prefixed with the project name listed verbatim, ⭐ **which this entry considers the most practically grounded detail here, since reserving teams really do work in spreadsheets**; ⭐⭐ **the contrast figure of more than ten thousand pre-computed datasets is a concrete number to compare against**; **and ⭐ its architecture diagram gives both ends verbatim, a spreadsheet side issuing requests through user-defined functions and a Python engine side listening, caching, filtering and pivoting to build a triangle and return it**, **with the repository measurably carrying a separated engineering layering of an add-in, an API, server components and a front end**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It turns authorisation for AI agents into a label with a scope** — one instruction file states verbatim that **the authorization is per component and that stopping one never authorizes stopping another**, and it lists each component’s cost and its post-deploy verification, stating for instance that stopping one component pauses every pending calculation and dependent-propagation job while another owning no runtime instance affects nothing running ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **authorisation is split per component with an explicit ban on extending one grant to another**, ⭐ **the most concrete account of what an agent may do that this site has collected, the same family as round 342’s custom non-open-source licence with a prior-permission list though here the object is agent operations**; ⭐⭐⭐ **verbatim, a change that has not passed its checks is never deployed**; ⭐⭐⭐ **verbatim, a failed build leaves the deployed component untouched**, with the failure path spelled out, since the build scripts abort rather than half-deploy and a live instance that will not stop in time or a rolled-back swap both preserve what is deployed, ⭐ **so failure is designed to be idempotent on the conservative side**; **and ⭐⭐ it requires the agent to state in the final response which components were rebuilt, redeployed and relaunched, or why none were, so what was touched travels with the reply**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ It commits its agent memory, skills and instructions into the public repository, which is this entry’s other side and the point needing the most annotation** — measurement shows **81 markdown memories**, one of them an index pointing at each memory; **6 named skills** each with a skill file, several also carrying an agent configuration for a second model family; **7 instruction files** split by topic including component deployment authorisation; **and three root-level agent documents** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **memory is stored one topic per file, making an agent’s experience a searchable asset**; **and ⭐⭐ one memory records an incident in which a supposed scratch rehearsal wrote into live data and gives three preventions** — ⚠️ **this entry does not reproduce the machine names, paths or class names involved, per this site’s standing practice, recording only the shape: a memory opening with a danger warning states that a scratch replay wrote to a live class, and gives three preventions, probing paths first, byte-copying the class first, and preferring the reason recorded in the gateway receipt**. **⑤ ⭐ One commit message pointing the same way as the version label**, read through GitHub commit search, is verbatim a fix to the methods module to **keep a calculated number at the precision it was observed with**, ⭐ **which this entry records as squarely in this round’s theme**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[chainladder-python]], [[reservingmodels]], [[verified-reserving]], [[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]], [[ibnr-app]] and [[insurance-analytical-case-studies]].

both raw probes returning 404**, **and the README returns no hit for licence, copyright or the copyright sign** — ⭐ **the most complete no-licence record this site has collected**, ⚠️ **absence meaning it is readable but that being readable and being redistributable are two different things**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ This entry flags something that matters more than the licence: the repository publishes
